translation.怀疑配置泄露时，可重置订阅凭据。重置后所有设备需要重新导入配置，账户登录不受影响: Reset subscription credentials if you suspect a leak. All devices will need to import the new configuration. Your account stays signed in.
translation.订阅凭据已重置，请到配置中心重新导入。: Subscription credentials reset. Go to Connect & download to import your new configuration.
translation.重置会更换订阅凭据及连接标识，旧链接和已导入的配置将失效。此操作无法撤销。: This replaces subscription credentials and connection identifiers. Old links and imported configurations will stop working. This cannot be undone.
translation.复制失败，请使用一键导入或扫码。: Copy failed. Use one-click import or scan the QR code.
translation.按日汇总近{{days}}天上传与下载用量，包含今天。: Daily upload and download totals for the last {{days}} days, including today.
translation.已根据当前设备推荐，可手动选择其他系统。: Suggested for this device. You can choose another system.
translation.打开客户端，更新配置，选择可用线路并启用连接。: Open the app, update your configuration, select an available route and connect.
translation.重置流量不会延长订阅有效期。: Resetting data does not extend your subscription.
translation.先选择适合的套餐，再确认费用和支付方式。: Choose a plan, then review the cost and payment method.
translation.优惠、旧套餐折抵和余额抵扣以创建后的订单为准。创建订单会预占可用余额，取消订单后: Discounts, plan credit and balance deductions appear in the created order. Available balance is reserved when you create an order and returned if you cancel.
translation.充值已到账，可在账户设置中查看余额。: Your balance has been credited. View it in account settings.
translation.订阅已开通，前往总览为设备导入配置。: Your subscription is ready. Open Overview to import your device configuration.
translation.开通结果将自动更新，请勿重复支付。: Activation status updates automatically. Please do not pay again.
translation.扫码支付后，页面会自动检查结果。: After scanning to pay, this page checks the result automatically.
translation.正在等待支付确认，请勿重复付款。: Waiting for payment confirmation. Please do not pay again.
translation.取消后，已抵扣的余额会返还。已付款时请先检查支付结果。: Applied balance is returned if you cancel. If you have paid, check the payment result first.
translation.本站采用邮件邀请注册，请从邀请邮件中的链接继续。: Registration requires an email invitation. Continue using the link in your invitation email.
translation.管理账户余额，或进入通知设置与账户安全。: Manage your balance, notifications and account security.
translation.通过邮件向朋友发送专属邀请，一起更轻松地使用 AI 应用。: Send a private email invitation and make AI apps easier to use together.
translation.邀请收益按当前站点规则结算。: Referral earnings follow this site's current rules.
translation.专属邀请仅限收件邮箱使用，7 天内有效。: Only the recipient email can accept this invitation, within 7 days.
translation.邀请已加入发送队列，请在跟踪邀请中查看状态。: Invitation queued. Track invitations to check its status.
translation.你正在接受发送到此邮箱的专属邀请。: You are accepting a private invitation sent to this email.
translation.两次输入的新密码不一致。: The new passwords do not match.
translation.修改密码后，所有设备都需要重新登录。: Changing your password signs you out on every device.
translation.密码已更新，请重新登录。: Password updated. Please sign in again.
translation.管理流量提醒和账户余额；密码可在账户安全中修改。: Manage usage reminders and account balance. Change your password in Account security.
translation.在总览中选择适合当前设备的导入方式。若无法打开客户端，请先安装客户端，再用系统浏: Choose an import option for your device in Overview. If the client does not open, install it first and retry in your system browser.
translation.先在总览确认套餐有效期和剩余额度，再更新客户端配置并切换可用节点；仍有问题时记录: Check your plan validity and remaining allowance in Overview, then update your client configuration and try another available node. Note your device and client version if the issue persists.
translation.先在订单详情检查支付结果。已付款仍未到账时，可从订单详情联系客服，订单编号会自动: Check the payment result in order details first. If a payment has not been credited, contact support from that order to include its number automatically.
translation.忘记密码可在登录页重置；其他账户设置可在账户设置中修改。请勿在工单中发送密码或完: Reset forgotten passwords on the login page and manage other preferences in Account settings. Do not send passwords or full subscription links in tickets.
translation.请先查看使用文档和排查建议；问题仍未解决时，再联系客服。已有未关闭的工单请继续回: Read the guides and troubleshooting suggestions first. Contact support if the issue persists, and continue replying to an existing open ticket.
translation.已有未关闭的工单请继续回复，避免重复提交。: Reply to an existing open ticket to avoid duplicate requests.
translation.请说明发生时间、设备与客户端、错误提示以及已尝试的排查步骤。: Describe when it occurred, your device and client, the error message, and the troubleshooting steps you have tried.
translation.你的网络服务，在一个地方轻松管理。: Your connection, subscription, and account. All in one place.
translation.使用邮箱验证码设置新密码: Reset your password using an email verification code
translation.复制失败，请手动复制链接: Could not copy. Select and copy the link manually.
translation.暂无可用支付方式，请联系客服。: No payment methods available. Please contact support.
translation.查看订阅状态，轻松管理你的网络服务。: Everything you need to stay connected, without the extra steps.
translation.此支付方式需要专用客户端，请选择其他方式。: This payment method requires a dedicated app. Choose another method.
translation.注册即表示同意: By creating an account, you agree to the
translation.登录以管理你的订阅与账户: Sign in to manage your subscription and account
translation.登录统一管理后台: Sign in to your admin console
translation.简洁连接，无限可能。: A simpler way to stay connected.
translation.管理密码、流量提醒和账户余额。: Manage your password, notifications, and balance.
translation.订阅链接包含你的访问凭据，请妥善保管。: Your subscription link contains access credentials. Keep it private.
translation.重置后，现有订阅链接将失效。继续吗？: Resetting will invalidate your current subscription link. Continue?
translation.选择已安装的客户端，直接导入订阅。: Choose an installed client to import your subscription.
translation.如果客户端没有打开，请先安装客户端，或复制订阅链接手动添加。: If the app did not open, install the client first or copy the link to add it manually.
translation.在另一台设备上扫描，或复制链接到客户端。: Scan on another device or copy the link into your client.
translation.订阅链接和二维码包含访问凭据，请勿分享。: Your link and QR code contain access credentials. Do not share them.
translation.服务没有返回 CSV 文件: The server did not return a CSV file
translation.管理账户信息、通知设置与账户安全。: Manage account details, notifications and security.
translation.请让已注册用户向你的邮箱发送邀请，然后打开邮件中的专属链接。: Ask an existing user to invite your email address, then open the personal link in the invitation email.
translation.此邮箱域名暂不支持注册，请使用允许的邮箱。: This email domain is not allowed for registration. Use an allowed email address.
translation.当前未配置可用的邮箱域名，请联系管理员。: No email domains are currently allowed. Contact the administrator.
translation.邀请链接不完整，请从邀请邮件中重新打开。: The invitation link is incomplete. Open it again from the invitation email.
translation.请朋友邀请你加入: Ask a friend to invite you
translation.请已注册的朋友向你的邮箱发送邀请，收到邮件后，打开其中的链接即可注册。: Ask a friend with an account to send you an email invitation. Open the link in the email to create your account.
translation.请求超时，请刷新确认结果后再试: Request timed out. Refresh to check the result before trying again.
translation.自动检查已暂停，订单仍可继续处理，请勿重复付款。: Automatic checking is paused. Your order can still be processed. Do not pay again.
translation.好友通过邀请注册后获赠 {{amount}} 额度。: Your friend receives {{amount}} in credits after registering through your invitation.
translation.好友首次实际使用流量后，再获赠 {{amount}} 额度。: Your friend receives another {{amount}} in credits after their first actual traffic usage.
translation.暂不开放新工单，已有工单仍可查看和回复。: New tickets are currently closed. You can still view and reply to existing tickets.
translation.完成购买后即可创建工单。: You can create a ticket after completing a purchase.
translation.赠送额度到账后 {{months}} 个月内有效。: Reward credits expire {{months}} month(s) after each grant.
translation.好友首次实际使用流量后，双方各获赠 {{amount}} 额度。: After your friend first uses traffic, you each receive {{amount}} in credits.
translation.好友注册礼: A welcome gift for your friend
translation.双方使用礼: A usage gift for both of you
translation.授权响应无效，请返回 App 重试。: Invalid authorization response. Return to the app and try again.
translation.授权已过期，请返回 App 重新登录。: Authorization expired. Start sign-in again in the app.
translation.授权未完成，请返回 App 重试。: Authorization could not be completed. Return to the app and try again.
translation.确认使用当前帐号登录你刚刚打开的 FastAI。: Confirm signing in to the FastAI app you just opened with this account.
translation.仅在你主动发起 App 登录时批准此请求。: Approve only if you initiated this app sign-in.
translation.这里展示账号登录会话，不代表代理在线设备。同一设备可能有多个登录会话。: These are account sign-in sessions, not active proxy devices. One device may have several sessions.
translation.退出此登录会话后，该客户端需要重新登录。已建立的代理连接不会因此立即断开。: This client will need to sign in again. Existing proxy connections will not immediately disconnect.
translation.请核对订单，选择支付方式后继续。: Review your order and choose how to pay.
translation.无需外部付款，确认后将处理订单。: No external payment is needed. Confirm to process your order.
translation.订单状态暂不可用，请刷新后重试。: Order status is unavailable. Refresh to try again.
translation.请确认付款钱包的币种与网络和所选渠道一致。: Make sure your wallet uses the currency and network selected here.
translation.网络连接中断，请检查网络后确认操作结果: Connection interrupted. Check your network and confirm the result.
translation.未能确认支付请求结果，正在检查订单状态，请勿重复付款。: The payment request result is unknown. Checking order status; please do not pay again.
translation.仅改变显示方式，套餐到期与流量重置时刻不变。: Only changes how times are displayed. Plan expiry and traffic reset instants stay the same.
translation.请先完成账号绑定，再申请入群。: Link your account before requesting to join.
translation.账号已停用，请联系网站客服。: Your account is disabled. Please contact website support.
translation.链接已过期，请重新获取。: This link has expired. Please request a new one.
translation.日期时间按 {{zone}} 输入和显示。: Dates and times are entered and displayed in {{zone}}.
translation.自愿订阅，可随时关闭；不影响验证码、账单和服务通知。: Optional subscription. Unsubscribe anytime; verification, billing and service emails are unaffected.
translation.订单与余额币种保持不变，付款金额按确认时的汇率锁定。: Your order and balance keep their currency. The payment amount is locked at confirmation.
translation.不适用当前套餐或周期: Not eligible for this plan or period
translation.先了解活动并领取优惠券，购买套餐时再选择使用。: Claim an offer, then apply your coupon at checkout.
translation.领取成功，已放入我的优惠券: Coupon claimed. You can find it in Coupons.
translation.领取失败，请重试: Could not claim coupon. Please try again.
translation.每人限领一次，数量有限，领完即止。: One per person. Available while supplies last.
translation.可以查看已有优惠券，或稍后回来。: Check your existing coupons or come back later.
translation.领取和管理员发放的优惠券都在这里，结算时选择使用。: Claimed and administrator-issued coupons appear here. Choose one at checkout.
translation.暂无优惠券，可前往活动中心查看: No coupons yet. Browse available offers.
translation.我已安全保存恢复码: I have securely saved my recovery codes
translation.密码已验证，请完成安全验证后继续。: Your password is verified. Complete verification to continue.
translation.验证码已发送，60秒后可以重新发送。: Code sent. You can resend it after 60 seconds.
translation.修改安全验证需要当前密码及已启用的验证方式。: Changing verification requires your current password and an enabled factor.
translation.使用身份验证器扫描二维码，或手动输入密钥，然后填写新动态码。: Scan the QR code or enter the key in your authenticator, then enter its new code.
translation.其他登录会话已退出，请重新登录。: Other sessions have been signed out. Please sign in again.
translation.更新后所有登录会话将退出。新恢复码会使旧恢复码失效。: All sessions will be signed out. New recovery codes invalidate previous codes.
translation.恢复码只显示一次，每个只能使用一次。请保存在安全的位置，不要与密码放在一起。: Recovery codes appear once and each works once. Store them securely, separately from your password.
translation.安全验证为可选项，默认关闭。邮件与身份验证器可同时开启，登录时优先使用身份验证器: Verification is optional and disabled by default. Email and authenticator can both be enabled; sign-in prefers the authenticator.
translation.恢复码已复制，请保存在安全的位置。: Recovery codes copied. Store them securely.
translation.无法复制，请手动选中恢复码保存。: Copy failed. Select and save the codes manually.
translation.输入身份验证器中的6位动态码。: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator.
translation.输入发送到账号邮箱的6位验证码。: Enter the 6-digit code sent to your account email.
translation.登录时验证账号邮箱中的验证码。: Verify a code sent to your email when signing in.
translation.使用身份验证器生成动态码，无需等待邮件。: Generate codes in your authenticator without waiting for email.
translation.确认退出全部会话: Confirm sign out of all sessions
translation.管理登录验证、设备会话与订阅凭据。: Manage login verification, device sessions, and subscription credentials.
translation.所有已登录的浏览器和 App 都需要重新登录，包括当前会话。订阅链接不变，已建立: All signed-in browsers and apps, including this session, will need to sign in again. Subscription links remain unchanged; existing proxy connections are not immediately disconnected.
translation.位置根据登录 IP 估算，可能显示代理出口所在地。: Location is estimated from the login IP and may show a proxy exit location.
translation.请返回 FastAI 完成登录。若客户端未自动打开，可点击下方按钮继续。: Return to FastAI to finish signing in. If the app did not open automatically, use the button below.
translation.在 Telegram 打开绑定链接后，请回到此页确认账号。无需发送密码或订阅链接: After opening the link in Telegram, return here to confirm the account. Never send passwords or subscription links.
translation.仅当这是你自己的 Telegram 账号时确认；如不认识，请重新生成链接。: Confirm only if this is your Telegram account. If you do not recognize it, generate a new link.
translation.群成员资格：套餐有效期内及到期后宽限期内可加入。: You can join while your plan is active and during the grace period after expiry.
translation.当前不满足入群条件，请先购买或续费套餐。: You are not currently eligible to join. Purchase or renew a plan first.
translation.解除绑定后将失去用户群资格，确认继续？: Disconnecting removes your eligibility for the user group. Continue?
translation.完成后返回此页刷新状态: Return here and refresh after completing the steps
translation.此时间因夏令时重复，请选择无歧义的时间。: This time occurs twice due to daylight saving. Choose an unambiguous time.
translation.此时间在所选时区不存在，请重新选择。: This time does not exist in the selected time zone. Choose another time.
translation.使用设备生物识别、PIN 或安全密钥登录。已启用的 MFA 继续生效。: Sign in with device biometrics, a PIN or a security key. Existing MFA remains required.
translation.绑定和删除需要当前密码及最近 5 分钟内的完整登录验证；会话过期时请重新登录。: Adding or removing a Passkey requires your current password and a full sign-in within the last 5 minutes. Sign in again if needed.
translation.站点尚未开启 Passkey，可查看或移除已有绑定。: Passkey is disabled. You can view or remove existing credentials.
translation.当前浏览器不支持 Passkey，请使用支持的 HTTPS 浏览器。: Passkey is unavailable in this browser. Use a compatible browser over HTTPS.
translation.移除后此 Passkey 无法继续登录，所有账户会话将退出。可用密码重新登录。: Removing this Passkey disables its sign-in and signs out all account sessions. You can sign in again with your password.
translation.当前浏览器不支持 Passkey，请使用密码登录。: Passkey is unavailable in this browser. Sign in with your password.
translation.Passkey 操作失败，请重试。: Passkey operation failed. Please try again.
translation.Passkey 验证已取消，请重试或使用密码登录。: Passkey verification was cancelled. Try again or sign in with your password.
translation.请选择本站已绑定的 Passkey。: Choose a Passkey registered on this site.

account.giftHint: Check your account before redeeming. Benefits and eligibility depend on the card.
account.giftDone: Your gift has been applied. Check billing and usage for your updated details.
account.notificationIntro: Choose the service updates you receive by email.

account.quotaHelp: When more than 95% of your plan allowance is used.

billing.billingIntro: Manage your subscription, balance and payments.
billing.choosePlan: Choose a plan to get started.
billing.balanceHelp: Your balance can cover subscription orders. Applied amounts appear before payment.
billing.usageIntro: Track usage and restore your allowance when needed.
billing.resetHelp: Use one banked reset to clear current usage. Your allowance, subscription expiry and scheduled reset date stay the same.
billing.bankedHelp: Granted by your administrator and stored for later. Expiring resets are used first.
billing.noResetHistory: No resets in the last 30 days
billing.resetConfirm: Use 1 banked reset to clear {{amount}} of current usage. This cannot be undone.
billing.resetSuccess: Usage reset. Your allowance is restored.
billing.inactive: An active subscription is required to use a reset.
billing.emptyUsage: There is no usage to reset. No reset will be spent.
billing.noCredits: No banked resets available. Administrator grants will appear here.

credits.completedHelp: Order processed. Check Usage for your current service status.
credits.help: Purchased credits last 12 months, work independently and survive plan resets.
credits.accessHelp: Purchased credits expire 12 months after receipt; earliest-expiring credits are used first. Active subscriptions retain their node access; otherwise basic nodes apply.
credits.access: Existing accounts keep their node group, speed and device limits. First-time access uses the selected credit package.
credits.noPlan: No active plan. Credits can be used independently.
credits.cancelledHelp: This order is closed. No further payment is needed.
credits.credited: Credits added. View your balance in Usage.
credits.deposited: Top-up received. View your balance in Billing.
credits.applied: This order was applied toward a subsequent plan order.
credits.paidResetHelp: Reset your plan traffic without using a banked reset. Your expiry date, scheduled reset and credit balance stay the same.

experience.adminStale: Update failed. Previously loaded data is shown below.
experience.analyticsUnavailable: Analytics is disabled or unavailable and stays off.
experience.analyticsStorageError: Unable to load or save preferences. Analytics stays off. Check browser storage permissions and try again.
experience.analyticsExperience: With your permission, we also count download clicks, successful or failed copying, import attempts and help opens, plus numeric LCP/INP/CLS and sampled API timings/error categories. We never collect subscription links, form contents, request addresses, error messages or stack traces. Clicks do not prove installation or connection success.
experience.analyticsSources: With your permission, we also measure referring website domains to understand how visitors find us. We do not record full referring URLs or link sources to accounts or payment records.
experience.analyticsExplanation: This site measures page visits, device categories and language without linking them to your account. Your choice is saved in this browser, and we may ask again after about six months. You can turn analytics off at any time. New collection then stops, and existing data is cleared according to the retention period. Order records and necessary security logs are unaffected.
experience.analyticsConsent: We use optional analytics to understand how our website is used and improve your experience. You can decline or change your choice at any time through Analytics preferences in the footer.
experience.analyticsSummary: Analytics helps us understand page visits and purchase steps without linking them to your account. Declining does not affect signing in, purchases or use of the service.
experience.analyticsSignal: Your browser requests no tracking. Analytics stays off.
experience.registeredLogin: Your account is ready. Continue signing in; you do not need to register again.
experience.missingCode: No code? Check spam and your email address. You can resend shortly.
experience.orderUncertain: We could not confirm order creation. Check your orders and continue any pending order before trying again.
experience.paymentReturn: Return here after paying for automatic confirmation. If charged, do not pay again. This order remains available in Billing.
experience.retryPayment: Restart only if you have not paid. If charged, check the result or contact support to avoid paying twice.
experience.startUsing: Next: open Quick Start to download a client and import your subscription. Existing clients can refresh their subscription.
experience.newTitle: Welcome. Set up your AI workspace
experience.newDetail: Your account is ready. Choose a plan, then configure your device.
experience.expiredDetail: Renew or choose a new plan to continue. Your account and orders remain accessible.
experience.bannedDetail: This account cannot use the service. Contact the administrator; buying a plan or resetting a password will not lift the suspension.
experience.exhausted: Your allowance is used up. Check your plan's reset or renewal options.
experience.unavailable: This plan has no available allowance. Contact support or review plan options.
experience.monthOnly: Daily upload and download totals for this month.
experience.verifyHelp: Enter the 6-digit email code. Check spam or resend if needed.
experience.passwordHelp: Use at least 8 characters and a password unique to this account.
experience.authIntro: Make your AI tools work more smoothly.
experience.authDetail: Device setup and helpful guidance, all in one place.
experience.deviceHint: Suggested for your device; installed apps cannot be detected.
experience.browserMenuDetail: Tap the app’s ⋯ or More button, usually in the top-right corner.
experience.browserChooseDetail: Look for Open in browser or a similar option and follow the prompts.
experience.browserPaste: Copy this page’s address, then paste it into your phone’s browser.
experience.browserCopied: Link copied. Open your phone’s browser and paste the address to continue.
experience.browserCopyHelp: Automatic copying failed. Press and hold the address below, then choose Copy.
experience.browserReason: Continue in your phone’s browser for reliable sign-in, device setup and payment.
experience.connectionHelp: Set up your device and start using AI tools.
experience.connectionDetail: Plan status, device setup and help, right here.
experience.freeRegister: Creating an account is free. Charges are shown before any paid action.

help.intro: Find your question and follow the steps.
help.empty: No matching questions. Try another keyword or browse the documentation below.
help.aStart: Open Setup, choose your device and client, then follow the installation and import steps. Check Usage for available plan data or independent credits before connecting in the client.
help.qImport: Why does one-click import not open the client?
help.aImport: Install the selected client and allow the browser to open it. From WeChat, QQ or Weibo, open this site in your phone browser first. If import still fails, copy the subscription in Setup and paste it into the client subscription import field.
help.qConnect: I imported the configuration. Why can I not connect?
help.aConnect: Check that your plan is active with data remaining, or that you have independent credits. Update the client configuration and try another available node. Check announcements for maintenance. If it persists, note your OS, client version, time and error message.
help.qCredits: How do plan data and independent credits differ?
help.aCredits: Active plan data is used first, then independent credits. Credits also work without an active subscription. They are measured in GB, accumulate, and are neither refilled nor cleared by plan resets. Your cash balance is for payments, not data.
help.qReset: When does usage reset? Does an early reset change expiry?
help.aReset: Usage shows the scheduled reset time and timezone, or says when no automatic reset is scheduled. A banked reset clears current plan usage without changing expiry or the original reset schedule. It does not restore spent independent credits.
help.qPayment: I paid. Why has my purchase not arrived?
help.aPayment: Open the order in Billing and refresh its status. Payment confirmation and processing can take time; do not pay twice. If it remains unresolved, use that order’s help link with the payment time and receipt. The order number is included automatically.
help.qCancelled: What happens to balance used on a cancelled order?
help.aCancelled: Cancelling an unpaid order returns any deducted account balance, which you can check in Billing. The receipt shows the returned balance; this is not a refund through an external payment provider. Do not pay a cancelled order. Place a new order if needed.
help.qSecurity: What if I forget my password or expose my configuration link?
help.aSecurity: Use Forgot password on the sign-in page. When signed in, open Account security from your avatar to change your password or reset the subscription link. Resetting invalidates the old link, so import again on each device. Never share passwords, codes or full configuration links, including in tickets.

landing.title: Less setup. More time with AI.
landing.intro: Clear guidance for AI app connectivity, desktop and mobile setup. Spend less time configuring and more time working, learning and creating.
landing.setupTitle: Three steps to a simpler setup.
landing.step1Text: Choose a subscription or standalone credits for your needs.
landing.step2Text: Use quick import or follow the illustrated guidance.
landing.step3: Get back to your AI tools
landing.step3Text: Find answers to setup questions in the help center.
landing.approachText: We help with connectivity and device setup for AI apps. Clear documentation, convenient imports and online support make each step easier to understand.
landing.q1: Is this an AI chat tool?
landing.a1: This workspace focuses on setup and guidance for using AI apps. Manage device configuration, read documentation and get support.
landing.q2: Can I use it on mobile and desktop?
landing.a2: Yes. Windows, macOS, iOS and Android are supported, with device-specific guidance to help you get started on your computer or phone.
landing.q3: Are AI app accounts or memberships included?
landing.a3: We provide environment setup and guidance, not third-party AI accounts or memberships. Check each app for its registration and payment requirements.
landing.a4: After signing in, open Help Center to browse common answers or search the documentation. If you still need help, contact support at the bottom of the page. Continue an existing conversation to keep progress together.
landing.footer: For a smoother experience with AI.
